sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of futibatinib during breastfeeding. Because futibatinib is 95% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. The manufacturer recommends that breastfeeding be discontinued during futibatinib therapy and for 1 week after the last dose.
